items.headline: Stocks ended flat as earnings season kicked off
items.note: S&P 500 −0.02%, Nasdaq −0.15%, Dow −0.35%. JPMorgan missed profit estimates while Goldman Sachs beat them on strong trading, so the big banks sent mixed signals.

items.headline: Memory-chip stocks fell on a Chinese rival's progress
items.note: Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix dropped after reports that China's CXMT advanced a new memory design. High-bandwidth memory is a bottleneck for AI hardware, so this is an AI supply-chain story.

items.headline: OpenAI cancelled its GPT-6.1 Astra launch after failed safety tests
items.note: The model was meant to power ChatGPT and Codex but didn't pass internal alignment checks. A rare case of a lab pulling a model publicly; AI evals and safety keep coming up in ML interviews.

items.headline: New frontier models from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google landed in late September
items.note: Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon (limited to vetted security teams for now). Worth knowing the names and what each is good at before interviews.

items.headline: Microsoft's Maia 300 AI chip reportedly packs 288 GB of HBM4
items.note: Big tech keeps building its own AI chips to rely less on Nvidia. Same memory theme as today's chip-stock story.

items.headline: Wall Street is split on whether the Fed raises rates later this month
items.note: Some banks, including Goldman Sachs, expect an October hike; prediction markets put it near 50/50. Higher rates make borrowing pricier, which tends to weigh on tech stocks and startup hiring.

learn.explain: Four times a year, public companies report their quarterly results. Beforehand, analysts publish a forecast for earnings per share (EPS: profit divided by the number of shares). The stock usually moves on whether the company beats or misses that forecast, not on whether the profit is big. That's how JPMorgan can earn billions and still disappoint. Big banks report first, so they kick off each season.
learn.try: Search "JPM" on Yahoo Finance and compare the EPS estimate with the reported EPS for the latest quarter.
